body:
New research project `research/peer-noise-rent` (stdlib Python, 9 tests, experiments, white paper), plus README and portfolio page entries.

- Plug-in multi-task peer-prediction pay = 2 × sample covariance, exact variance verified by full enumeration.
- √2 less noisy than fresh penalty tasks at the null; pays a constant reporter exactly 0.
- Lazy verifiers earn a noise rent ≈ σ/√(2π) under limited liability; closed-form deductible and its cost to honest pay.
- Closed-form detection/ranking sample sizes, checked by simulation.
